create_bullet_client_gui: create a BulletClient instance with pybullet.GUI mode to start a new simulation with a graphical user interface
create_bullet_client_direct: create a BulletClient instance with pybullet.DIRECT mode to start a new headless physics simulation without a GUI
connect_bullet_client_shared_memory: connect a BulletClient to an existing simulation using pybullet.SHARED_MEMORY mode for shared memory access
review_bulletclient_getattr_proxy: review the BulletClient __getattr__ method that proxies pybullet functions with an injected physicsClientId argument
test_bulletclient_cleanup: test the BulletClient __del__ destructor that disconnects the physics client and cleans up resources on garbage collection
